# meok-tacho-audit-mcp

> UK haulage tachograph audit + drivers' hours + DVSA OCRS Red prevention. Smart Tachograph 2 (July 2026 cliff), EU 561/2006 retained, infringement triage, Public Inquiry brief generation. By MEOK AI Labs.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- check_smart_tacho_2_readiness
- analyze_drivers_hours
- summarize_infringements
- calculate_ocrs_band
- forecast_ocrs_90_day
- generate_public_inquiry_brief
- audit_weekly_downloads
- check_dvs_pss_3_star
- check_drivers_cpc_expiry
- generate_dvsa_visit_pack

## Install
```
pip install meok-tacho-audit-mcp
```

- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/meok-tacho-audit-mcp/
